capabilities: Edit calendar events as list lines in Daily Notes
Insert event references from any note
Bidirectionally sync events with a CalDAV calendar
Resolve conflicts between local and remote edits
disambiguation: Not a calendar view or CalDAV client; it only edits events as Markdown lines and delegates the calendar UI and CalDAV connection to Full Calendar Remastered.
extras: README warns to test with a disposable calendar and keep backups of both vault and calendar before trusting it; some UI labels appear only in Chinese (授权, 处理冲突); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; documentation includes SECURITY.md referenced from the README.
intentEvidence: Full Calendar Remastered remains the calendar client and the remote CalDAV collection remains the source of truth.
motivation: The author built it for people who plan and journal in Markdown but use a dedicated calendar app for calendar views and system reminders.
problem: People who plan and journal in Markdown have no way to keep Daily Note event lines and a real CalDAV calendar in sync, so calendar views and system reminders live in a separate app.

relations.evidence: It asks Full Calendar Remastered to read or mutate the selected calendar through a scoped JavaScript API.

requires.name: Full Calendar Remastered with a writable CalDAV calendar source

summary: Calendar-event bridge that edits CalDAV events as plain list lines in Obsidian Daily Notes and syncs them through the Full Calendar Remastered plugin.
